Progress

Accrued runtime

Total time the daemon has actually been alive, summed across every start/stop. Completion is 7 days of THIS, not 7 days on the calendar -- a machine switched off overnight ages no process.

Accrued runtime still needed to reach 7 days.
Wall clock
3d 10h 00m since first start
Calendar time since the soak first began. The gap versus accrued runtime (0m) is time the machine spent off or asleep -- expected, and the honest reason a soak started last week is not done.
Sessions
20 (3 ended unclean)WATCH
One daemon start-to-stop is a session; their runtimes are added up. 'Unclean' means no graceful shutdown arrived -- a crash, a hard reset, an OOM kill. A few over a week is normal; a rising share means something keeps killing the daemon.
